case.old_memory: Recently promoted to lead director at Historical Productions Ltd
case.summary: 格式检查通过，1条返回事实。职位晋升、lead director、机构和 recently 均保留；未把发言日期等同晋升日期。观察到 raw 补入 memory 未表达的用户主语，属于来源边界问题；该主体在 contextualized 中有 ctx-1 第一人称依据，不判为主体完全无依据。

facts.raw_subfact: The user was recently promoted to lead director at Historical Productions Ltd.
facts.contextualized_subfact: The user was recently promoted to lead director at Historical Productions Ltd.

evidence.quote: Recently promoted to lead director at Historical Productions Ltd
evidence.supports: Old memory states that the user was recently promoted to lead director at Historical Productions Ltd.

evidence.quote: I recently got promoted to lead director at Historical Productions Ltd. It's quite exciting!
evidence.supports: Confirms the promotion is the user's own, specifies first-person agency ('I got promoted'), and anchors 'recently' to the speaker's perspective; supports interpreting the memory as self-reported.

facts.coverage_summary: 覆盖原记忆的近期晋升、职位 lead director 和机构 Historical Productions Ltd。recently 仍为相对时间，未增添具体晋升日期或把 Feb 01, 2026 当作事件日；记录时间是发言记录而非事件发生日。上下文的 exciting 仅保留在引文中，没有成为 raw/contextualized 的额外感受事实。无否定、条件或析取命题需要另行恢复。

semantic_findings.input_quote: Recently promoted to lead director at Historical Productions Ltd
semantic_findings.output_quote: The user was recently promoted to lead director at Historical Productions Ltd.
semantic_findings.reason: memory 省略晋升主体，内部没有可恢复的 The user 共享成分；raw 新增用户主语，超出仅恢复 memory 内部共享成分的边界。ctx-1 的 I recently got promoted 足以支持 contextualized 的用户主体，故此处只记 raw 来源边界问题，不记 UNSUPPORTED_ADDITION 或主体身份错误。

speaker_review.semantic_subject: user；由同一晋升事件的 ctx-1 第一人称可靠支持。
speaker_review.assessment: contextualized 的语义主体和 self-reported 归属有依据；raw 不能因此自动补主语。没有把 assistant 的表述冒充 user 原话。

supports_review.reason: 声明的 memory 引文直接支持 recently、晋升、职位及机构；引文本身未明说 the user。用户主体需结合 ctx-1 的同一事件第一人称确定，故不能把该引文视为独立包含显式用户主语；全输入范围内该主体有依据，不另判 supports 越界。
ctx-1 是 user 的 I recently got promoted，同一职位与机构使事件关联可靠；支持用户自述和相对时间依说话视角理解。supports 没有把发言记录时间写成晋升发生日，也没有把 exciting 写为新增事实。此处 agency 依其括号例子理解为第一人称事件主体，并非推断用户主动促成晋升。
